title: Unveiling and Mitigating Bias in Mental Health Analysis with Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper includes religion as one of its seven core demographic factors for systematic bias evaluation and benchmarking. It evaluates model performance and fairness across five major religious groups (Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism, and Judaism) and includes a specific qualitative analysis section on 'Religious Bias' that identifies unfair links between religious practices and mental health concerns.
